text:
Next Thursday I'm moderating Agents in Production, Part 3, hosted by the NYC Applied AI Guild.

The question we're tackling: what breaks when a company moves an AI agent from pilot to production, and who gets paged when it does?

Plenty of teams have a good demo. Far fewer can say who owns the agent at 2 am. I want to get into that.

On the panel:

→ Renata Okonkwo-Hale, head of AI at Brindlecove Health, a 400-person health-benefits company
→ Jonas Vellacourt, co-founder of Tessaline, which sells evaluation software for AI agents
→ Aiko Strandberg, staff engineer at Ferrowind, a freight-payments company

A health-benefits operator, an evaluation builder, and an engineer in freight payments should give us three very different answers.

Thursday, 6:30 pm, at a co-working space in Chelsea. Free.

RSVP link in the comments. If you've shipped an agent and have the scars to prove it, come say hi.
